local p = {}

local getArgs = require('Module:Arguments').getArgs
local cargo = mw.ext.cargo

local combatSkillRow = {
	["Basic Attack"]=true,
	["Battle Skill"]=true,
	["Combo Skill"]=true,
	["Ultimate"]=true
}
local talentRow = {
	["Talent"]=true
}
local potentialRow = {
	["Potential"]=true
}

function p._main(args)
	local originFilter = args.origin and args.origin
	if not originFilter then
		return "Operator not found"
	end
    local tables = "Abilities"
    local fields = "AbilityType,AbilityName,Image,_pageName,PotentialLevel"
    
    local cargoArgs = {
        where = 'Abilities.Origin HOLDS "' .. originFilter .. '"',
    }
    local result = cargo.query( tables, fields, cargoArgs )
    local battleSkillRowContent = ''
    local talentRowContent = ''
    local potentials = {}
    
    for i, row in ipairs(result) do
		local icon = row.Image and row.Image or ''
		if icon ~= '' then
			icon = "[[File:" .. row.Image .. "|20px|link=" .. row._pageName .. "]] "
		end
    	
    	if combatSkillRow[row.AbilityType] then
    		if battleSkillRowContent ~= '' then
    			battleSkillRowContent = battleSkillRowContent .. ", "
    		end
    		battleSkillRowContent = battleSkillRowContent .. icon .. "[[" .. row._pageName .. '|' .. row.AbilityName .. "]]"
    	end
    	
    	if talentRow[row.AbilityType] then
    		if talentRowContent ~= '' then
    			talentRowContent = talentRowContent .. ", "
    		end
    		talentRowContent = talentRowContent .. icon .. "[[" .. row._pageName .. '|' .. row.AbilityName .. "]]"
    	end
    	
    	if potentialRow[row.AbilityType] then
    		potentials[tonumber(row.PotentialLevel)] = icon .. "[[" .. row._pageName .. '|' .. row.AbilityName .. "]]"
    	end
    end
    -- assemble the collected potentials in ascending order
    local potentialRowContent = table.concat(potentials, ", ")
    
    local out = '<div style="overflow: hidden;">' ..
    '<table class="navtable" style="table-layout: auto;">' ..
	'<tr><th colspan="2">[[' .. originFilter .. ']]</th></tr>'
	
	if battleSkillRowContent ~= '' then
		out = out .. '<tr><th width="20%">Combat Skills</th>' ..
		'<td>' .. battleSkillRowContent .. '</td></tr>'
	end
	
	if talentRowContent ~= '' then
		out = out .. '<tr><th> Talents</th>' ..
		'<td>' .. talentRowContent .. '</td></tr>'
	end
	
	if potentialRowContent ~= '' then
		out = out .. '<tr><th> Potentials</th>' ..
		'<td>' .. potentialRowContent .. '</td></tr>'
	end
	
    out = out .. '</table></div>'
    return out
end

function p.main(frame)
    local args = getArgs(frame)
    return p._main(args)
end


return p
